acceptance_criteria: Define a versioned model artifact manifest contract for Flange QC v2 detector artifacts.

Add a Python manifest loader/validator that accepts only explicit JSON manifests and rejects raw weights, unknown schema versions, missing required metadata, unsafe path references, production authority, and non-shadow mode.
Add a detector adapter path that can use a validated artifact manifest to emit review-only observations while preserving the rule that detector output cannot emit PASS or NG.
Health and docs expose that the current model state is manifest-ready but still shadow-only and approval-gated.
Tests cover valid manifest load, invalid/unsafe manifests, detector integration, and no production authority.
Required local checks pass and no restricted behavior is introduced.

memory_preflight.query: flange_qc_v2 model detector MLOps artifact boundary
retrieved_decisions: GitHub issues, PRs, docs, tests, contracts, and gate artifacts are source of truth.
Current detector output is shadow-only and cannot emit PASS or NG.
MLOps owns dataset management, model training/evaluation, model registry, promotion criteria, production accuracy gates, raw dataset retention, privacy controls, rollback, and shadow evaluation.
The app owns detector adapter interface, safe states for missing/unapproved model evidence, and explicit contracts.
retrieved_lessons: Prepare integration boundaries before hardware or model artifacts arrive.
Do not introduce production authority through scaffold or metadata work.
Keep raw datasets, raw media, weights, and secrets out of app-code PRs.
restricted_areas: customer data/raw media/raw datasets/raw transcripts/source dumps/patches
model weights/model deserialization/training notebooks/TensorRT engines/ONNX/PyTorch execution
